data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs held a project kickoff meeting to establish a pilot for the Nimbus Ledger Sync tool to automate UPI reconciliation. The team agreed on a scoped go-live date of November 30, 2026, and outlined technical deliverables including sandbox access, mapping documents, and security requirements.
decisions: The pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.
Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only, excluding NEFT and IMPS.
Data will be hosted primarily in AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore.
